prompt: Create a high-quality professional studio product photograph of crispy golden chicken nuggets on a clean seamless white background. Center the composition slightly to the right with exactly 7 nuggets total: 5 whole nuggets stacked vertically in an uneven neat tower on the right, 1 whole nugget leaning upright against the stack in the front-left foreground, and 1 bitten nugget piece in the front-center foreground showing moist white chicken inside with a jagged bite edge. Place exactly 1 small round white ceramic dipping sauce cup on the left, filled with smooth creamy orange dipping sauce with subtle swirls on the surface. The nuggets should be irregular oval shapes with deeply textured crunchy breading, warm golden-orange color, tiny dark seasoning specks, crisp crumb detail, and appetizing highlights. Use soft diffused studio lighting, realistic shadows under the food, shallow but clear product-photography focus, a low eye-level angle, no props, no text, no logo, and a polished commercial fast-food advertising look.

promptZh: 创作一张高质量的专业摄影棚产品照片，主体为 香脆金黄鸡块，背景为干净无缝的 白色。构图略微偏右，总共放置 7 块鸡块：右侧垂直堆叠 5 块鸡块，形成一座错落有致的塔状；左前方放置 1 块竖立的完整鸡块；正前方放置 1 块被咬了一口的鸡块，露出内部鲜嫩的白色鸡肉，咬痕边缘参差不齐。左侧放置 1 个小型圆形白色陶瓷蘸酱杯，内盛质地细腻的 橙色蘸酱，表面带有细微的纹理。鸡块应呈不规则椭圆形，裹粉质感深邃，色泽呈暖金橙色，带有细小的深色调料颗粒，面包屑细节清晰，并呈现出诱人的光泽。使用柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光，食物下方带有真实的阴影，采用浅景深但焦点清晰的产品摄影手法，低平视角度拍摄，无道具、无文字、无 Logo，呈现出精致的商业快餐广告质感。
